output.reason: The linked PR [ev-7dc94aee3ebf] names the flags it adds to `argocd admin import`: the conflict flag is `--override-on-conflict`, which forces the update. No flag called `--retry-on-conflict` exists, so the subject name is wrong. The change type 'added' is right, as the release note [ev-a5b549ff42a5] and the PR's changed files [ev-17522a387f41] show. The second flag, `--skip-resources-with-label`, is a separate subject and is not covered by this assertion.

correction.statement: A new flag, --override-on-conflict, was added to the argocd admin import command. When it is set, a resource is forcefully updated if its resourceVersion conflicts.
